notes.title: The God - 4 Years
notes.content:
Hey there! It's been a while (again) since we posted something. But we've got plenty of amazing news!

[h1]The God[/h1]
One of our first serious games (The God) is celebrating [b]4 years on the market[/b]! We would like to thank you for being with us for such a long time and we are really glad The God is keeping 'mixed' reviews.
We aren't officially working on The God at the moment, so there may not be any updates. But we've got a great announcement for you - The price is going down! We are lowering the product price from [b]12.99$ [/b]to [b]6.99$[/b].
We've heard many people complaining about the price and we agree that the tiny 4 year old game should now be cheaper! We hope this change will bring many new 'gods' and it will remain current.
If you have anything else to say about this, just let us know!

[h1]Cellings[/h1]
We would like to introduce to you our new creative-sandbox game title [b]Cellings[/b]! We really do love creative/sandbox games.
Cellings is a creative sandbox game taking place in an abstract procedural world full of various species. Experience the full evolution of cells across 3 generations, compete with other species, and explore breathtaking worlds.
Our Spore-inspired sandbox game with satisfying mechanics will take you to a stylized world where magic happens! Be a part of a complete cell evolution and experience 3 generations - Neural Adaptation, Relational Adaptation, and Biological Adaptation. Create your own cell with various parts you collect during your journey and compete with other species to progress even further.
More information about the game here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808730/Cellings/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1808730/Cellings/[/url]

[h1]Our Community[/h1]
We decided to create our official community Discord channel! Join and introduce yourself (who are you, what you are working on, looking for a job?), let us know about your feedback on our games (The God, Cellings, The Fallen Kings, and others) and meet other people with similar interests!
We would like to expand our small indie studio and we do really like this kind of communication - being as close to the community as possible! Join us and let's make new & unique games.
Community Discord channel: [url=https://discord.com/invite/4NhQcSpsK4]https://discord.com/invite/4NhQcSpsK4[/url]

With love,
Struct9 team
[url=https://struct9.com]https://struct9.com[/url]

notes.title: The God patch 1.0.2 official release date
notes.content:
Hey! We are still here and we would like to announce upcoming great patch! Official release date of the patch 1.0.2 is [b][i]20th September[/i][/b].

The upcoming new patch will bring you brand new features such as interactive weather, realtime snow simulation, advanced weather affection, keybinding and many more. More below.
(Please if you can't see GIF images, wait a minute!)


[u][b]Upcoming official features in the patch 1.0.2[/b][/u]

[b]• Realtime Snow Simulation[/b]
[i]We've been working on a new feature called the Snow Simulation! Now the weather will be much more aggressive and you will be able to enjoy it's interaction![/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1xloek0usjTPNgSIRe/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Hot Surface[/b]
[i]You will be also able to change sun intensity and destroy your whole world. The world can burn in flames![/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/8TCbbkol26DTtfNBJv/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Advanced Surface Interaction[/b]
[i]It's a very similar feature like above. In the new patch you will be able to interact the surface with everything. It's very satisfying to see how that smooth surface can be easily deformed.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jaBf6jy8bvOyKq1C79/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• More Weather Affection![/b]
[i]Yes! The weather will be very crazy! Almost everything will be possible. For example rain drops will affect the snow surface.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7SWw9kqKW3HIivoUbW/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Better Look[/b]
[i]The overall gameplay has changed and you can look forward to much more smooth movement, editor interaction and world creation. You will be also able to edit your own controls [keybinding] if you play the game with PC.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/bSuTcnagNp7d8zB5CU/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Level Of Detail[/b]
[i]You might notice that it's much more detailed and much more smooth. We've updated our systems and graphical protocols. Our new shader system is much more effective and you will definitelly enjoy it. Satisfying things are coming![/i][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32690207/deeb7142d9754399ecc07a045331b472b0dfb568.png[/img]

You can await many more improvements and features. Of course, there are many bug fixes. Hope you will like the upcoming patch!

[b]- Struct9 Team[/b]

notes.title: The God patch 1.0.1 official release date
notes.content:
We would like to announce upcoming patch full of improvements, news and updates. Official release date of the patch 1.0.1 is [b][i]2nd July[/i][/b].

In the upcoming patch you can look forward on [b]2 new modes, human-like perspective, improved intelligence of living beings, new weather and many more[/b]. 
(Please if you can't see GIF images, wait a minute!)


[u][b]What the patch 1.0.1 will bring?[/b][/u]

[b]• Be More Creative[/b]
[i]Choose between 2 new game styles that will make your world more alive or vice-versa. Updated ambient occlusion will add much better taste to shape your terrain as you wish! This option can be found in Options panel.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jVkojIzvgVn2jIGWhW/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Darwin Is Here![/b]
[i]Finally you are able to choose evolution mode in custom-world editor. If you choose Evolution mode, you will be able to see your creations evolve or even fight each other. Predators are able to defend their territories or they can even start figthing. Humans will be able to gather resources from the nature.  If you reach specific amount of resources, your evolution level will increase and humans will start building new structures! Every living being has own lifetime so they might get sick or they can die too early. Its up to you how you manage your life in your world![/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Ahh36uAT38WZQrB0fI/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Animals Are Finally Animals[/b]
[i]We've got here a big improvement in artifical intelligence not just for humans but also for animals. Animals are able to evolve and increase their territory. Each creature has also own lifetime, so it might die too early or too late. It's really beautiful to see tiny, little bears! They are also able to fight each other (yes, penguins win in the gif!)[/i] 
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/ddxjnEikZK5Kbhs5LX/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• The God As A Human[/b]
[i]Human-like perspective is a brand new feature that everybody will like. In the objects menu, press the small button in the left corner. You will become a human! Explore the surface and if the humans reach second level of the evolution, they will start building huts which are very useful to progress further in their development. Its such a beautiful view down there![/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/1Xe0ZDKD8hzm6bcqzP/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Do Not Make Them Too Big![/b]
[i]Humans could be very crazy sometimes. If you resize them and they are too big, they will become big monsters that will destroy literally everything! Watch out![/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/w6YCmWU2cl8JAvIlO9/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Bloomy World[/b]
[i]You are able to edit bloom intensity which is that shiny and intense post-effect. You are very free to edit it, you can even turn it off! In short - its brightness.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RLXfz9npwOktxYaDZJ/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Wind, Wind, Wind[/b]
[i]New weather addition allows you to control wind intensity! Its just an interesting effect that affects fragile objects. We would like to improve and add more settings for weather, especially for world affection in the future.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/WNJVjXUuizhjTQuiix/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]• Make Them Grow, More And More[/b]
[i]Yes, the new patch brings a small weather-affection such as wind and this little feature! If it starts raining and you are in Evolution mode, you will see how your world is slowly increasing! Trees might re-grow which is very useful for people.[/i]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/cXVeUy2e3GFP4Tmqay/giphy.gif[/img]

And you can look forward on many many more improvements and updates. In the day of patch release we will upload the Introduction Patch video which will inform you about the last news in The God. Keep following the game and we will let you know very soon! Thank you!
- Struct9 Team
